The '''Takeover at Whisper Base''' was an [[Alliance Special Operations/Legends|Alliance Special Operations]] mission to capture [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Lasre Dardano]]'s [[Whisper Base]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]].

==Prelude==
[[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Lasre Dardano]] established [[Whisper Base]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] in order to spy on his [[Politics/Legends|political rival]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Corlen]]. The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] wanted to capture the base to use as a forward operating site. Four operatives were sent there, and after trekking through the jungle, they reached the base.<ref name="Takeover" />

==The battle==
They cut the comm lines in the garage ambushed a team of [[Imperial Army trooper/Legends|Imperial Army troopers]] to take their [[Code cylinder/Legends|code cylinders]]. They then encountered the [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|BX-series droid commando]] [[BX-2R|Toor]] refitted as a maintenance droid in the base. They then disabled the [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]] [[Nilos (Lambda-class)|''Nilos'']] to prevent the base commander [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Sarev]] from escaping. With that done, they proceeded to the command center and made their way past [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]]. Once inside, they discover that Sarev had gotten into the escape tunnel and was heading to the comm station to warn Moff Dardano.<ref name="Takeover" />

They then chased after Sarev and defeated his [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|AT-ST]], securing the base.<ref name="Takeover" />

==Aftermath==
The operatives then secure their position in the base<ref name="Takeover" /> and were soon forced to [[Battle of Whisper Base|defend]] against Moff Dardano's counterattack.<ref name="OS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Takeover forms the campaign in [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[2014]] adventure [[Takeover at Whisper Base (adventure)|''Takeover at Whisper Base'']]. The characters face seven key encounters in the game.<ref name="Takeover" />
